label: Microsoft Teams (Bot)
description: Ask MindsHub from Teams chats and channels.
notice: A bot, not a data connector: connecting lets you ask MindsHub in Teams. MindsHub only sees the messages you send it or @mention it in, never your other Teams messages.

form.title: Microsoft Teams (Bot)
form.subtitle: Ask MindsHub from Teams chats and channels.

methods.label: Connect
methods.description: Connect, then send MindsHub a message in Teams: you're paired by your Microsoft sign-in name, which must be your MindsHub email. Guest accounts can't connect. Disconnect here at any time.
